messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: HelixPay asked for a multi-region demo config tomorrow — primary AP South (ap-south-1) with a US fallback for failover. They want a short allowlist + big burst window while they run partner-driven load tests. Renewal check-in in 21 days, so this is important. Can SRE pin ap-south-1, fallback us-west-2, allow 198.51.102.0/24 and 203.0.114.8/29 for 8h, and grant QPS 320 with burst 700? Customer HP-2044.

Samir (Acct Exec): They mentioned strict cert auth on the partner side. If we can guarantee deterministic routing and stable latency it helps lock renewal. I'll be on the call.

Noah (SRE): We can do region pin + fallback routing policy. For cert auth do they want mTLS at our edge or just header validation? Also need exact IP list and token header. Prefer CIDRs rather than individual IPs for partner rotation.

Priya (CS): Partner NATs: primary pool 198.51.102.0/24, secondary small pool 203.0.114.8/29. They will present client certs for mTLS; header X-HP-Auth will also be present. Window: 2026-07-01T12:00:00Z -> 2026-07-01T20:00:00Z (8h). They requested audit logs, short retention for demo traces, and auto-revoke after window.

Jin (Solutions): Recommend KV-cache prefill 2h before and a gradual 20m ramp. I'll upload a harness to warm common prefixes and a brief test set to exercise edge cases. Also suggest we enable the fallback routing to us-west-2 only after sustained error rate > 0.8% or p95 > 300ms for 5m.

Noah (SRE): Sounds good. I'll do a 15m canary in ap-south-1 starting 30m before window and then roll. Config payload I'll apply below. Need explicit approval for mTLS assert at edge.

Priya (CS): Approve mTLS assert. Please include rollback thresholds: p95 > 280ms or errors > 1% during canary. Also capture renewal flag: if demo p95 < 160ms and error < 0.5% for 24h we escalate to an enterprise pricing conversation (Samir to own).

Noah (SRE): Applying canary config snippet: ```json
{
  "customer_id":"HP-2044",
  "primary_region":"ap-south-1",
  "fallback_region":"us-west-2",
  "allowlist":["198.51.102.0/24","203.0.114.8/29"],
  "auth":{"mTLS":"required","header":"X-HP-Auth"},
  "rate_limits":{"qps":320,"burst":700},
  "start":"2026-07-01T12:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-07-01T20:00:00Z",
  "canary":{"duration":"15m","start_offset":"30m","rollback_p95_ms":280,"rollback_error_pct":1},
  "fallback_policy":{"trigger_p95_ms":300,"trigger_error_pct":0.8,"window":"5m"},
  "telemetry":"masked_prompts_aggregate_short_retention",
  "audit_log":true,
  "notes":"8h multi-region demo; mTLS assert at edge; auto-revoke; warmup 2h prior; escalate on success for renewal"
}
```

infra-bot: Request received. Ticket CS-7688 created. Initiating canary in ap-south-1 at 6205551350. Requestor: Noah.

Noah (SRE): Canary started at 6205551350. Quick smoke: p95 142ms, errors 0.15%. mTLS handshake success rate 99.9%.

Noah (SRE): Canary healthy -> rolling to full for HP-2044 in ap-south-1. Full apply at 6205551500. Fallback policy in place but inactive.

Priya (CS): Great :rocket: I'll message HelixPay with the window, mTLS cert reminder, and the header to include. Samir  can you prepare a renewal playbook and conditional offer tied to the success metrics? Jin  please share the warmup harness link.

Samir (Acct Exec): On it. Drafting a conditional proposal: 12-month enterprise pilot if post-demo p95 < 160ms and errors < 0.5% across 24h. Will add to renewal folder.

Jin (Solutions): Warmup harness uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/HP-2044 and scheduled to run 2h before start. Link: https://internal.storage/warmups/HP-2044

Priya (CS): Closing loop. Auto-revoke set for 2026-07-01T20:00:00Z. We'll collect telemetry and attach to the account. Thanks team! :tada:
